newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Jaya Jusco debuts at 7.90 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Jaya Jusco debuts at 7.90 rgt.

text.p: Retailer Jaya Jusco Stores Bhd listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board on Monday at 7.90 ringgit, versus a 4.30 ringgit offer price.
At 0140 GMT, the stock was trading at 7.50 ringgit. The company had made a public issue of eight million shares.

For the year ended February 1996, the operator of a chain of department stores reported a pre-tax profit of 24.78 million ringgit and a net profit of 16.46 million ringgit, or 38.2 cents a share, on turnover of 451.87 million ringgit.
It has forecast pre-tax profit of 33.10 million ringgit for the year ending February 1997 and net earnings per share of 39.5 cents.

In a research note issued on Monday, Jupiter Securities said it estimates fair value on Jaya Jusco at 8.65 ringgit. It said the potential growth for the local retailing industry "is promising", with an estimated sales growth of 14.9 percent in 1996.
"In addition, with a population of over 20 million and a growth rate of two percent expected over the next five years, outlook for the industry is buoyant," the report said.
